SL01.rationale: Area chart shows growth trajectory; contrast box highlights stark zero-research reality

SL02.rationale: Vertical stack connects policy gap to Flash Crash precedent to SGE educational concern

SL03.rationale: Research sandbox at center with questions radiating outward shows comprehensiveness

SL04.rationale: Industry-standard format for technical audiences; emphasizes three-layer separation

SL05.rationale: Three arrows meeting at September 2025 visualizes 'perfect timing' argument

SL06.rationale: Metrics-heavy dashboard familiar to executives; establishes concrete achievements

SL07.rationale: Venn-style relationship diagram shows complementarity, not competition

SL09.rationale: Standard executive format; includes risk mitigation for proactive objection handling

SL10.rationale: NOT asking vs. Asking contrast lowers perceived commitment and clarifies the ask

design_principles_applied: Gene Zelazny: One chart, one idea
Information hierarchy: Most important information most prominent
Contrast for emphasis: Use color/size to highlight key points
Takeaway annotations: Every visual explicitly states its conclusion
